how: The tradable version: the headline all-stocks book entered at 9:35 (entry (c) of the intraday check) instead of the opening print, exit at the store's close, on the 5-minute window's common positions; costs 5 bps on each of the 4 stock trades a day (20 bps) plus 1 bp a side on the netted twin legs (half the saved 2-bp tc). Net -7.03 bps a day; after_cost = 252 x mean daily net (-17.7); (1 + mean)^252 - 1 = -16.2; t of the daily mean -1.38; gross +16.20 bps a day (t +3.18).
